node.title: LEAP: at the crossing radii the extremal words are the planted sunflower family
node.statement: REVISED per the E15 COUNTEREXAMPLE (#197): the naive planted-only form is FALSE — a structured low-slack NON-planted challenger exists at sigma = 1 in the toy cell. Revised statement: at the crossing radii the sup-over-words list is controlled by the planted sunflower family plus the priced low-slack challenger/envelope supplied by `worst_word_challenger_pricing`. Exact two-class exhaustion would close this cleanly, but the downstream arithmetic only needs a certified rowwise envelope with matching unsafe witnesses. The observed challenger is structured (not a fifth-mechanism signal); the endgame arithmetic gains one priced column rather than an unpriced supremum.
node.attack_surface: toy probe: search word families at n = 16..64 for lists exceeding the planted count at matched radius; the L1 sunflower machinery prices any challenger's structure
node.falsifier: a toy word family beating the planted list at a crossing radius
